mechanism: Disulfiram may inhibit alcohol metabolism and increase acetaldehyde accumulation, which could potentiate gastrointestinal side effects of liraglutide; liraglutide delays gastric emptying which may affect disulfiram absorption and efficacy.
action: Monitor for increased GI adverse effects; counsel patient on strict alcohol avoidance as liraglutide intensifies nausea/vomiting risk; ensure disulfiram therapeutic levels are maintained with possible dose adjustment if absorption is compromised.
